name: search_products
description: Search the catalogue by keyword and return matching products with their price and the units available across variants. An unrecognised category is rejected rather than returning an empty result set. Results are product-level summaries and do not carry per-variant SKUs.

query.description: Free-text keywords matched against product name, description and category.

category.description: Restrict results to one category. Must be one of the listed values.

in_stock_only.description: When true, exclude products with no units available in any variant.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return.

error_returns.when: query is empty or category is not a recognised category.
